justification: Paid granny flat PDF cited the wrong instrument (cl 4.18, Sch 3 Subdiv 4) and stated standards Schedule 1 does not set (3 m separation, 5 m wall height) or sets differently (side setback, POS).

break_it.scenario: owner keeps 3 m from the house because the PDF said so
break_it.what_happens: they lose buildable area for a rule that does not exist
break_it.repro: read Separation row on origin/main PDF
break_it.how: row now says Not set by Schedule 1; test pins it

break_it.scenario: owner of a 1000 m2 lot uses the 3 m rear setback
break_it.what_happens: a CDC could be refused for too small a setback
break_it.how: row and footnote state the 450-900 m2 band and that larger lots need more

break_it.scenario: certifier checks a citation in the PDF
break_it.what_happens: cl 4.18 / Sch 3 Subdiv 4 point at the wrong instrument
break_it.how: every row cites a Schedule 1 section; test fails on the old citations

post_merge.manual_verify: generate a granny flat PDF and read the Development standards table

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the PDF or report page contains cl 4.18, Sch 3 Subdiv 4, a 3 m separation or a row without a Schedule 1 section
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main granny-flat-report.tsx lines 784-790 cite Sch 3 Subdiv 4 and state Min 3 m separation
